newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swisscargo sets up new service centre.
newsitem.headline: Swisscargo sets up new service centre.

text.p: Swisscargo AG, the cargo unit of Swissair AG, said it would combine its reservations and customer service activities into one unit from February 1, the Customer Service Center Switzerland at the Zurich airport.
Decentralised cargo reservation locations in Basle, Berne, Lugano and Zurich will be combined in the new centre.
The center will use Automatic Call Distribution that identifies the origin of the call and then passes it on to the appropriate operator that speaks in German, French, Italian or English.
Customers will also be able to inquire about the status of any shipments at any time during day or night.
